hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: AWS-MMS is a PWA: technicians record whole visits offline on iPhones and Android phones, and nothing may be lost or duplicated. Before doing anything else in this session, load the `pwa` skill with the Skill tool and answer its pre-flight questions (device, network, lifecycle, data loss, storage, caching, security, proof) for the task. For back-end-only work, still check the effect on the device (sync contracts, idempotency, auth refresh, caching headers, CSP, presigned uploads). Open findings F1-F14 are in .claude/skills/pwa/references/findings.md; raise any that the task touches.
